title: When Guidance Becomes a Guard: Early Interception of Unsafe Inputs in Text-to-Image Generation
title_zh: 当引导成为守卫：文生图生成中不安全输入的早期拦截

paragraphs.en: 研究提出CSTI方法，利用扩散模型的引导信号在生成早期拦截不安全输入，无需修改模型即可显著降低风险与延迟。 Text-to-image diffusion models can produce unsafe content, while output filtering intervenes only after synthesis. We investigate whether native generation signals enable early detection of unsafe and adversarial inputs. We find that classifier-free guidance exposes strong safety signals in conditional responses, accessible through compact statistics and linear readouts. Based on this finding, we propose Conditional Semantic Trajectory Interception (CSTI), which aggregates activation contrasts between conditional and unconditional responses at early checkpoints for calibrated risk detection. CSTI fits concept-specific detectors using canonical concept and safe examples, without attack samples, intermediate image decoding, or generator modification. Across five generators, four adversarial attack collections, and two general NSFW datasets, CSTI achieves the strongest overall performance among six baselines at a matched 5% FPR. Early interception reduces generation latency by over 60% on intercepted paths. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of native conditional responses for early safety interception.
paragraphs.zh: 研究提出CSTI方法，利用扩散模型的引导信号在生成早期拦截不安全输入，无需修改模型即可显著降低风险与延迟。文生图扩散模型可能生成不安全内容，而输出过滤只能在合成完成之后进行干预。 我们研究能否利用原生生成信号在早期检测不安全输入与对抗性输入。 我们发现，无分类器引导在条件响应中暴露出强烈的安全信号，可通过紧凑的统计量和线性读取器获取。 基于这一发现，我们提出条件语义轨迹拦截（CSTI），该方法在早期检查点聚合条件响应与无条件响应之间的激活对比，以实现经校准的风险检测。 CSTI 仅使用规范概念示例与安全示例来拟合概念特定的检测器，无需攻击样本、中间图像解码或对生成器进行修改。 在五个生成器、四个对抗攻击集合和两个通用 NSFW 数据集上，在匹配的 5% 误报率下，CSTI 在六种基线方法中取得了最强的整体性能。 早期拦截使被拦截路径上的生成延迟降低了 60% 以上。 这些结果表明，原生条件响应在早期安全拦截中的有效性。
